San Antonio, TX Commercial Heating & Cooling Services

Businesses big and small can benefit from quality commercial heating and cooling services. Enjoy fast help with our professional HVAC solutions designed for commercial properties. Call us today at (210) 987-5587 to discuss your needs and schedule an immediate appointment.

Since 2003 we have provided commercial HVAC services to customers in and around San Antonio, TX. We work hard to develop and maintain long lasting relationships with small businesses, restaurants, strip malls, assisted living communities, grocers, cold storage facilities and more.

We offer businesses the most efficient heating and air conditioning systems available. Our expert staff will assist you in selecting new equipment and guide you towards the best option. All of our services are tailored to meet your property’s specific needs.

In some cases, our expertise can go beyond just heating and cooling. Some of our customers utilize large refrigeration units for cold storage that we help to maintain. We also assist customers with their walk-in coolers. No matter what heating or cooling system you have on your property, our professionals can help you make sure they are running in top condition.
We Provide Service, Maintenance and Commercial Replacements. We Also Provide Move In and Move Out Inspections for Property Managers.
New AC Installation & Repair Services

Does your air conditioning system often give you trouble? You may have an aging system that needs to be replaced. Some of these outdated systems are literally being held together with bailing wire and toothpicks. Before allowing these units to stop functioning altogether, get the professional help you need.

At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air we have the tools and equipment needed to return your system to normal again, no matter the problem. Our expert repair services will get to the source of the problem and make sure the issue does not recur.

Similarly, should the damage be too far gone, you can also contact us for air conditioning replacement and installation. We will help you find the right product for your needs. Our staff works within your budget to ensure that any new installation is offered at a competitive price and able to handle the demands of your commercial property.
